job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities:
1. Own demand generation for our B2B analytics product in the APAC region: content, webinars, paid campaigns and events.
2. Work with sales to define lead quality and hand-off, and report on pipeline contribution every month.
3. Manage a budget and two junior marketers.
4. Build messaging and case studies with customers.

Requirements:
1. 5+ years in B2B marketing, at least 2 in SaaS.
2. Hands-on experience running campaigns end to end and measuring results.
3. Fluent English; this role works with a global team every day.
4. Experience managing people is a plus.

candidate.name: Emma
candidate.resume_text:
Emma Lin, marketing professional, 7 years of experience.

Education:
2015 to 2019, Example University, BA in Communications

2023 to present, Sample Cloud Ltd., Senior Marketing Specialist
- Ran webinar program: 14 webinars a year, average 220 registrants, contributed 18% of sales pipeline in 2025.
- Launched a customer case study series with 9 published stories.
- Managed paid search budget of 600k RMB a year.

2019 to 2023, Demo Events Co., Marketing Executive
- Organised trade show booths and partner events.
- Wrote newsletters and social media posts.

Skills: marketing automation tools, analytics dashboards, copywriting.
